errors.evidence: The prompt instructs to avoid making comparisons between lines, but the phrase "In contrast" explicitly compares the trend of the 'cluster' tokenizer to the 'universal' tokenizer.
The data point for the 'universal' tokenizer at 100k is visibly below the 40.5% grid line, closer to 40.45%.
The data point for the 'cluster' tokenizer at 100k is closer to 41.6% than 41.7%.
The prompt requests a description of each line including its line style (e.g., solid, dashed). The description omits that both lines are solid.
